text:
sarah: cutting RC for prod window tonight (02:00-04:00 PDT). patch set includes kv-cache warmup fix + batching tweak. tagging artifact sha a1b2c3d4. requesting pin of runtime and infra, canary schedule, and QA signoff. abort criteria: 95p latency >200ms OR error rate >3x baseline for 5m. please ack and list any hold blockers.

deploy-bot: build created -> https://ci.redwood.example/builds/a1b2c3d4 (artifact rc-2026-03-21-001). to promote run: `/deploy promote rc-2026-03-21-001 --env prod --pin --canary`
```
/deploy promote rc-2026-03-21-001 --env prod --pin --canary --canary-steps=5,25,100 --step-interval=30m
```

alex: ack, i'll pin runtime image and infra bits now. pinning runtime-image:v2026-03-21@sha256:abcd1234 and infra-ami:ami-0cffee12345. will update infra pin comment in the release ticket.

nish: telemetry hooks: enabling canary span sampling and log-level DEBUG for canary only. smoke tests to run during canary: `kv-warm`, `batching-e2e`, `latency-p90-check`. will attach smoke test IDs to the promotion.

carol: small release notes snippet attached below. copy for release notes page and changelog: 
- kv cache warmup: avoid double-warm on restart
- adaptive batching: reduce small-request overhead
- fixes for memory accounting in runtime
(cherry-picks: #4521 #4524)

qa-bot: QA smoke run passed on rc-2026-03-21-001 (kv-warm, batching-e2e) — all green. logs: https://qa.redwood.example/reports/rc-2026-03-21-001/smoke

oncall: sheriff acked. i'll be primary contact during window. deadman configured: if abort criteria tripped, promotion will auto-pause and page oncall. make sure rollback playbook is ready.

sarah: thanks. request: set initial canary 5% for 30m, then 25% for 30m, then 100% with 10m observation after final. also please enable kv pre-warm on canary nodes only.

deploy-bot: promotion scheduled at 02:15 PDT. promotion metadata: {artifact: rc-2026-03-21-001, pinned_runtime: runtime-image:v2026-03-21@sha256:abcd1234, canary_steps: [5,25,100], abort_criteria: [latency_p95>200ms, error_rate>3x], rollback_playbook: https://wiki.redwood.example/rollback-rc}

alex: runtime pin completed and annotated in ticket. noted the rollback playbook link.

nish: telemetry links added to promotion: https://telemetry.redwood.example/query?id=rc-2026-03-21-001-canary. will monitor p50/p95/p99 + error trends.

carol: release notes updated on docs site. PR: https://docs.redwood.example/changes/rc-2026-03-21-001

qa-bot: final QA sig: `qa:approved` — no regressions found on staging.

oncall: confirmed abort thresholds set in deploy system and deadman switch enabled. oncall roster paged.

sarah: final check before go: anyone see any reason to hold?

alex: +1 from infra. no holds.

nish: +1 telemetry.

carol: +1 docs.

deploy-bot: promotion started at 02:15 PDT — canary 5% applied. trace_id=trc-9f8e7d6c. monitoring windows open.

sarah: rolling. please escalate immediately if anything abnormal. :thumbsup:

oncall: watching. will call abort if thresholds break.
